status: frozen before fitting predictors or inspecting their errors
population: Within-pi0.5 checkpoint/intervention generalization, not independent architectures
cohort: Unmodified-prompt pi0.5 protocol; first pass per weights hash; repeat passes reserved for noise diagnostics
grouping: Nine manually frozen intervention blocks; these are NOT independent ancestry families. All checkpoints share pi0.5 and some cross-block parents.
outer_validation: 3 repeated 3-fold intervention-group partitions, 3 nested base-task anchor orders
fixed_test_tasks: 16 base tasks per anchor draw, common to every anchor budget; remaining 24 form nested anchor pools
training_policy_target_results: Allowed: model predicts missing cells of held-out checkpoints on tasks observed for training checkpoints
test_policy_target_results: Never supplied to fitting, tuning, or anchors
tuning: Inner intervention-group CV using Brier score, exact same anchor/target split; conservative grid tie order
metrics: Brier primary; base-task by perturbation-axis mean-score MAE and pairwise agreement secondary. Ranking compares jointly held-out checkpoints, real observed gap >=0.10; prediction ties count half.
aggregation: Average cases within base task and checkpoints within intervention group, then equal task/group weights. Rankings macro-average eligible pairs within base-task-by-axis cell, then tasks.
intervals: Paired base-task cluster bootstrap after averaging repeated splits; descriptive, conditional on observed checkpoints; no independence claim for related checkpoints.
sensitivity: Two-way camera-intervention versus noncamera holdout, and run-A repeat-pass noise diagnostic
constraints: No robot-policy inference/training, simulation rollouts, physical trials, paid calls, or synthetic episodes
